verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PAT-based bearer auth tied to specific capability scopes (e.g., commerce.order:*, commerce.channel:read), satisfying 'scoped API credentials,' but there is no evidence of real 2FA on the registrar account itself, and no mention of IP allowlisting for API access anywhere in the docs pack. missing for 10: 2FA/MFA documentation for account login, IP allowlisting/IP restriction feature for API tokens, independent confirmation these controls exist.
